title: Surreal Horse Artist
description: A brown horse with glasses sits at a black stump desk, holding a yellow pencil in its hoof and drawing in an open sketchbook. Above it looms a giant stylized green eye with a purple iris containing a black horse silhouette, surrounded by a blue snake, floating smiley faces, bats, and colorful dripping paint against a vibrant cosmic background.
prompt: A surreal psychedelic painting of a brown horse wearing glasses sitting at a black stump desk, holding a yellow pencil and drawing in a sketchbook. A giant green eye with purple iris and black horse silhouette dominates the top, with a blue snake wrapping around the horse, floating smiley faces, bats, and dripping colorful paint. Vibrant green purple and blue cosmic background with text elements like HOOF STRIKE and DREAM JOCKEY on rocky formations.
